title: Cafe’nMe
notes: Editorial selection, independent of repository activity or star counts. Claims and screenshot checked against the public README on 2026-10-23: https://github.com/naiplawan/cafe-nme#readme (docs/screenshots/pos-sale.webp). The outcome describes implemented functionality, not measured adoption or impact.
description: A café point-of-sale application connecting tablet checkout, shop administration and LINE membership.
problemStatement: Café staff, owners and customers need different interfaces that share orders, menu data and loyalty rewards.
solution: A tablet POS, web admin and LINE member card backed by a NestJS API and PostgreSQL.

value.contribution: Built checkout and menu-management flows alongside the API and LINE membership integration.
value.designDecision: Keep the staff checkout, owner admin and customer member card distinct, while sharing the order and loyalty data behind them.
value.outcome: The implemented flow connects orders and payments to stamps and rewards, with sales reports for owners. The screenshot uses demo café data.
value.screenshotAlt: Cafe’nMe tablet checkout with a drink menu, customizable cart items and payment total
value.screenshotCaption: Tablet checkout using the repository’s demo café and orders.
